answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A comet ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A sparrow expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A terrace renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 9569 identities cost 2793 paid peers, 293684 tokens of stake and 37705 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
